verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent is documented as working independently in the background to complete tasks like a human developer. It can be triggered automatically when an issue is opened, and completed work can be reviewed and merged from GitHub, which together cover the issue-to-PR flow. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that assigning an issue produces an opened pull request, documentation of PR creation details (branching, tests, descriptions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end issue-to-PR results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Set up an automation to run Copilot automatically, on a schedule or in response to events such as an issue being opened.
let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
Launch work from GitHub, track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work
Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
